question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Receive
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Exile**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Receive** means to accept or take something that is given, offered, or sent. (प्राप्त करना)

 
 
• **Example:** She was delighted to receive a letter from her friend after many years.
 
 
 
• **Exile** means Exile” is to send someone away, to banish, or to drive out. (निर्वासन)
 
 
• **Example:** The king was forced into exile after the revolution.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **‘Receive’** is **‘Exile’**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Exile**.

 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Admit** (स्वीकार करना): To acknowledge or confess something as true.

 
 
• **Example:** He had to admit that he made a mistake.
 
 
 
• **Reward** (इनाम): Something given in recognition of service, effort, or achievement.
 
 
• **Example:** The student received a reward for her academic excellence.
 
 
 
• **Fund** (निधि): A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** The project was completed using funds from various sponsors.
